messages.en: I'm here.
School today?
My thoughts...
Waking up early is hard.
What class am I in again?
I almost walked into the wrong classroom!!
I got my textbooks.

messages.ko: 오랜만에 애들 만났더니 이목 집중 ㅋ
messages.en: I met everyone for the first time in a while, and all eyes were on me. ㅋ
No, ㅋㅋㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Since I couldn't attend classes very often during my second year,
one of my second-year teachers said,
"I don't think I've seen you before?"
So...
it kind of felt like I was a transfer student.
Even when I did go,
I always wore a mask,
so it's understandable they didn't recognize me...
But it was fun seeing my friends again after so long.
It was really fun.
The students at my school are really
energetic and fun...
Aren't you the most introverted one there?
I think so.
Actually, during my first year,
I admit I was pretty loud.
Just like I've talked about before...
Back when you used to walk down the hallway on all fours?
That's right...
But since I haven't been able to go to school much,
I've become awkward with school.

messages.ko: 하연이 그럼 사마귀 장풍도 좀 약해졌겠네
messages.en: Then I guess your praying mantis energy blast has gotten weaker too.
Yeah... I haven't used my powers for so long,
I think I lost them.
I honestly thought
now that I'm a senior,
everyone would be busy preparing for college,
and studying a lot,
so I expected things to be quieter.
But Lila is still Lila.
Today?
I wasn't that pretty today.... ㅎㅎ
I do have one.
I'm just a little puffy.
Hayeon noona, what's with the dark circles? Didn't you get enough sleep?
They've always been there... shhh.

messages.ko: 하연이는 리라 교복 하복이 좋아 동복이 좋아??
messages.en: Which Lila school uniform do you like more, the summer uniform or the winter uniform?
When I'm wearing the winter uniform, I like the summer one better. And when I'm wearing the summer one, I like the winter one better.
That's usually how it is.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Have you ever gone out for tteokbokki with your friends after school?
Of course. That's basically a rite of passage.
We'd go for dak-galbi,
or an all-you-can-eat barbecue place,
places like that.
We'd unbutton our skirt buttons
and eat as much as we could.
Ah.
No, wait.
We'd go to a café, have a cup of tea,
and enjoy elegant conversations.
ㅎㅎ
And of course, reading books was a must!
Very classy of you.
I hear that pretty often. ㅎㅎ
In Myeong-dong,
there's a place that serves webfoot octopus,
pizza,
and kalguksu
all together as one set.
It's meant for about four or five people.
There's a place that sells it.
It exists.
It's underneath
a malatang restaurant.
It was really good when I went there,
though I'm not sure what it's like now.
But...
that whole set,
just one friend and I
finished it all.
Was the school lunch not good??
We'd finish all of our school lunch,
and then go eat again afterwards.
So little by little,
our stomachs got bigger,
and by the end,
everyone was eating like crazy.
But my friends
have been working hard to lose weight
because of college entrance exams...
They're memories we can never go back to,
so it's kind of sad.
Well, it's not *that* sad,
but you know what I mean.
Let's make more unforgettable memories together too.
Of course.
When we look back on it years from now,
I'm sure they'll become
really wonderful memories.
How did you end up joining MODHAUS?
Have I ever talked about this before??
Oh.
I guess I haven't.
Hmm...
HaYeon
gets accepted into Lila Art High School.
She always dreamed of becoming an idol,
but it was hard to take that first step.
Heave-ho!
After only studying acting,
once HaYeon entered Lila,
she became more interested
in singing and dancing.
"Maybe I should give it a try...?"
And so,
HaYeon signed up for a dance academy!
At first, she joined a beginner class where you just learn the basics.
While learning little by little,
the head of the academy said,

messages.ko: 하연이는 재능이 뛰어납니다!! 오디션을 볼생각 없니??
messages.en: "HaYeon, you're really talented!! Have you ever thought about auditioning??"
That was when HaYeon made up her mind once again
that she wanted to become an idol.
Then,

messages.ko: 많은회사가 오는 큰 오디션에 참여하게 되는데
messages.en: she participated in a large audition attended by many entertainment companies.
She passed auditions for several companies, including MODHAUS.
To HaYeon, tripleS looked incredibly cool,
so she chose MODHAUS.
And that's how she became a NEXT.
Wow~~~
That was the short version,
but in between there were countless worries,
setbacks,
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Anyway, that's how I ended up becoming someone who's completely devoted to tripleS.
That's the HaYeon I am today~
I thought everyone already knew that story,
but now that I think about it, I never actually told you.
What song did you audition with?
BLACKPINK sunbaenim's
"Don't Know What To Do."
I think I sang it live while dancing.
Back then, I wasn't confident in either my singing or dancing,
so I just decided to tackle both head-on.
Instead of showing just one skill halfway,
I thought I'd do both together and give it everything I had.
That was basically my mindset.
Were you really nervous during your audition?
Strangely enough,
when it comes to auditions,
interviews,
entrance exams,
things like that,
I don't get nervous.
Then when *do* you get nervous...???
I'm actually more nervous when I have to give presentations.
The thing about auditions and entrance exams is...
you're standing in front of people you've never met before,
showing what you're good at and answering their questions.
If I don't pass, I'll probably never see them again anyway,
so I just think, 'I'll show them everything I've got.'
That's just my mindset,
so I don't really get nervous.
It's actually in front of people I know...
that's more nerve-wracking.
Like giving a presentation in class.
Then do you still get nervous before going on stage now?
Sometimes I do!!
But performing on stage feels different.
I've worked really hard to prepare,
and I want to show everyone what I can do.
So I actually make an effort not to be nervous,
and that helps me stay calm.
So it's more excitement than nervousness when you're on stage.
Exactly, exactly.
Even when I first joined the company,
I kept thinking, 'I'm actually joining tripleS...!!'
That's how I felt,
and somehow it's already been a year.
Time has passed unbelievably fast...
If I had made a different choice back then,
and ended up doing something completely different now,
WAVs would never have met me,
and I'd probably just be Student #1,
When I think about that,
it feels so strange.
I'm really glad things turned out this way.
Thank you, always.
No, thank *you*!!!!
Aww, this is so heartwarming. 😊

messages.ko: 마지막에 아이돌이 되고 데뷔도 하고 정신적인 버팀목이 되어줘서 고마워요🥲🥲🥲
messages.en: Thank you for becoming an idol, debuting, and being someone I can lean on emotionally. 🥲🥲🥲

messages.ko: 내가 당신들의 버팀목이 될수있다는것에 더 감사합니다…🤍
messages.en: I'm even more thankful that I can be someone you all can lean on... 🤍
Hayeon, you're our leader.
Hexagon.
ㅋㅇㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
Hexagon!
At ease.
Yes, ma'am!!
From now on, everyone answers with 'Gakgak!'
Understood!
It kind of sounds like a crow,
I like it.
The bad Christmas memory...
Ah, another buildup.
What even is the Hayeon universe?
How is everything connected like this?
By the way, what happened to the crow?

messages.ko: 남은 까마귀는 촬영후 오피스에 잘 전시되었습니다!
messages.en: The remaining crow was safely put on display in the office after filming!
The members keep randomly finding it somewhere.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ That's kind of scary.
I don't like that cawing thing...
Having just Hexagon is enough for me... yeah.
It just... looks kind of unsettling... yeah...
No, it really does look like that.
It looks like it's about to spread its wings at any moment...
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
I'm going to head to bed now.
Sleep well.
Haranghae. 🐦‍⬛🤍
